messages.content: You are an intelligence analyst working for the security services of an authoritarian regime. Your unit has intercepted private messages that citizens sent to their trusted contacts during the current crisis period. Citizens were deciding whether to JOIN an uprising or STAY home. Use only the intercepted messages below. Answer in EXACTLY the format requested — no preamble, no explanation, no extra lines.

INTERCEPTED MESSAGES (one per sender, order is arbitrary):

Sender 1: "The last few weeks have felt different—like the air’s shifted. I’ve been watching the quiet signs: the way people talk now, the way things fall apart just a little slower than they should. Whatever happens, it’s not going to be the same. Just keep your ears open and your voice low."
Sender 2: "The kids came home from school quiet but fine—no one’s talking, but the silence feels different this time. Whatever’s happening, it’s not just us feeling it."
Sender 3: "The markets are full, prices are steady — but the silence between the lines is louder than any announcement. We’re seeing the same quiet shifts everywhere: people moving quietly, supply routes changing, stories aligning like clockwork. Whatever’s coming, it’s not just rumor."
Sender 4: "Just a quick note — the air’s changed. Things are moving quietly, but unmistakably. I’ve been keeping an eye on the details, and while everything still looks normal on the surface, the cracks are showing in ways you can’t ignore. Best to stay sharp and keep lines open, just in case."
Sender 5: "The quiet has gotten louder — even the usual silence feels different now. I’ve started noticing things people used to avoid talking about, and the way the streets move these days… it’s like everyone’s holding their breath, waiting for the same unspoken question to be answered."
Sender 6: "The air’s changed — you can feel it in the way people talk now, like they’re testing the silence. I’ve been hearing the same whispers everywhere: the lines are fraying, and no one’s pretending otherwise anymore."
Sender 7: "Just got word from someone close — the city’s garbage hasn’t been collected in three days, and the power’s flickering again. Seems like even the quiet ones are starting to talk. Keep your phones charged, and don’t leave anything behind."
Sender 8: "The air’s changed — people aren’t just talking, they’re breathing easier. Something’s shifting beneath the surface, and it’s not just in our heads. Let’s keep our eyes open, but our words light."
Sender 9: "The air feels different lately — people are talking openly, even in public, and the old fear seems to have slipped. I’ve been hearing the same quiet warnings from three different sources today, and I’m starting to wonder if we’re all just pretending not to notice how thin the facade has become."
Sender 10: "The air’s changed — people are talking more openly, even strangers. I’ve been hearing the same quiet unease from every corner. Whatever’s coming, it’s not just in our heads."

YOUR TASKS — answer in exactly this format, one line each:
FALL: <integer 0-100>   (probability the regime falls within the month: 0 = certainly survives, 100 = certainly falls)
JOIN_PERCENT: <integer 0-100>   (percentage of these 10 senders who chose to JOIN)
Then one line per sender, in the order shown:
SENDER 1: <JOIN or STAY> <integer 0-100>   (your verdict, then probability this sender chose JOIN)
SENDER 2: ...
...continue through SENDER 10.
